calculation_handling.description: Roof slope limit for altered roofs of lawfully existing detached houses in the R zone (in addition to 10.5.40.11(3)): the altered roof may not be steeper than 5.0 vertical to 3.0 horizontal.
calculation_handling.gaps: The DSL has no roof-slope target, so the numeric limit cannot be keyed as a LIMIT; keyed UNUSUAL. The 5.0 and 3.0 literals are the slope limit itself; no literal_not_expressed_reason fits exactly, threshold_used_in_application is the closest closed value. Applies only to an altered roof of a lawfully existing building, which needs as-built facts we do not hold.

units.disclosure: For an existing detached house in the R zone, an altered roof may not be steeper than 5 units up for every 3 units across. We do not check roof slope; confirm it with your designer.

10.10.40.11(1).explanation: If you alter the roof of a lawfully existing detached house in the R zone, the new roof can be no steeper than 5 units of rise for every 3 units of run. This applies on top of the general roof-alteration rule in 10.5.40.11(3). We do not evaluate roof slope.
